short_blurb: Kitchen & bath remodels, room additions, and new construction in Bellflower.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Bellflower. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Bellflower, including Bellflower proper, Lakewood adjacent, Downey adjacent, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Bellflower?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Bellflower building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Bellflower?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Bellflower rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Bellflower remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
